name: test
on: [push]
jobs:
  unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3.12 -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: --no-compile -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q

"""Feed parsing."""

from lxml import etree

from feedparse import main


def test_parses_feed():
    assert etree.fromstring(main("<a/>")).tag == "a"
